title: Change list
description: Derived from design/EVALUATION_INTERFACES.md 1.0 (Draft); the document wins. Proposal: Tillman Heisner accepts, changes or replaces it (Evaluation interfaces, section 4). What was removed, changed or added in one entry variant, and where (section 4.1 rule 6): one row per change.
$comment: Derived from design/EVALUATION_INTERFACES.md 1.0 (Draft); the document wins. Section 4.1 rule 4 leaves the file format (CSV, JSON or another) to the builder; this file describes the JSON form, with one object per row in rows. Key names that section 4 does not give are marked 'Proposed name' in their description. Kept on the expected side only (3.2). Family ids are the ones Tillman Heisner chooses from section 5 (for entry variants, for example E1 to E8, S2, S3 or DV10); they are not fixed here.

item_id.description: The item the file is for (4.1 rule 1).

variant_id.description: The variant the file is for (4.1 rule 1).

input_files.description: Proposed name. The input-side files the expected file was built for, each with its SHA-256 (4.1 rule 1). If a checksum no longer matches, the scorer skips the item and reports it.

evaluation_interfaces_version.description: Proposed name. The version of design/EVALUATION_INTERFACES.md the file follows (4.1 rule 1).

expected_file_version.description: Proposed name. The version of this expected file; a reviewed finding goes into a new version, and scores name it (4.1 rule 5).

canary.description: Only if canaries are adopted (5.3): the file's canary, random and at least 32 characters long. Option CS7, a canary in every row, would add a row field.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 checksum: 64 hexadecimal characters, computed by software (Evaluation interfaces 3.1).

input_file.description: One input-side file the expected file was built for, with its checksum (4.1 rule 1). Field names from Evaluation interfaces 3.1.

row_key.description: The key of an expected-value table row: (object_type, anchor_xpath plus anchor_label, field) (4.2).

xpath.description: The location of the change, as an xpath.

passage.description: The location of a hand-made change, as the hand-marked passage.

action.description: Proposed name. What the change did (4.1, item 6).

old_text.description: Proposed name. The text before the change.

new_text.description: Proposed name. The text after the change.

affected_rows.description: Proposed name. The expected-value table rows the change affects; may be empty (family E7).

family.description: Proposed name. The family of section 5, for example E2.

pending.description: Proposed name. true for a row not yet settled: left out of scores and listed (4.1 rule 3). Frozen test-set files hold no pending rows.
